concept: ELB: NLB — Layer 4, millions of requests/s, preserves client IP
tests: Choosing a load balancer type for very high TCP load with ultra-low latency and source IP preservation.
expected: Network Load Balancer — Layer 4 (TCP/UDP/TLS), millions of rps, ultra-low latency, preserves the client source IP. Triggers: "millions of requests per second", "TCP", "ultra-low latency", "preserves client source IP".
why_not: ALB — Layer 7 for HTTP(S); Classic — legacy; Gateway Load Balancer — for inserting virtual appliances.
